cycling peritoneal dialysis (CCPD). CAPD requires no ma-
chine and can be done in any clean, well-lit location. Th e usual
dwell time is four to six hours, followed by the draining of 
used dialysate and its replacement with fresh solution requir-
ing an additional thirty to forty minutes. Most patients change
the dialysate solution at least four times a day and sleep with 
the solution in their abdomens at night. CCPD does require a 
machine called a cycler to ﬁ ll and empty the abdomen three to 
ﬁ ve times during the night. One exchange is then done during 
the day with a dwell time that lasts the entire day. An additional 
exchange can be added in the afternoon for some patients.
